sources.role: Ryujinx-derived data roots, Config.json/input profiles, Switch keys/firmware, saves and state feature boundary
official Ryubing setup, portable mode, keys and firmware guidance
Ryubing keys and firmware import filenames

paths.path: ~/.config/Ryujinx/Config.json (or a portable data root selected with -r)
paths.naming: JSON Config.json; controller profiles are JSON files under the Ryujinx input profile directory and store backend/id/controller_type plus button_a/button_b/... and stick/trigger fields
evidence: docs:Ryubing setup guide Config.json and portable mode

paths.path: Ryujinx data root input profiles plus Config.json
paths.naming: Input profile JSON uses fields such as backend=GamepadSDL2, id=<SDL device id>, controller_type=ProController, button_a=A and button_b=B; GUI Input > Configure Controllers writes the profile

paths.path: ~/.config/Ryujinx/system/prod.keys and optional title.keys (portable system/ when -r is used)
paths.naming: Exact cryptographic key filenames prod.keys and title.keys; no canonical checksum is published for user-dumped keys
Switch firmware is installed NCA content selected by the BIS registered-content layout, not one BIOS filename; no canonical firmware checksum is published by this runtime record
Per-title account/system save directories use Nintendo Switch title-ID-derived numeric directory names and contain title-created files

paths.path: No save-state subsystem is documented in the pinned Ryubing/Ryujinx desktop runtime
paths.naming: Unsupported; Switch title saves are not emulator save states
JSON Config.json; input profiles are JSON records with backend/id/controller_type and button/axis fields
evidence: docs:Ryubing setup guide default and portable paths

paths.path: Ryubing input profiles under the selected data root
paths.naming: Input profile JSON fields include backend, id, controller_type, button_a/button_b/... and analog/trigger fields; GUI controller configuration writes the file
Exact filenames prod.keys and title.keys; no canonical checksum is published for user-dumped keysets

Unsupported; title save data is not a save state
